src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Adding a product
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Adds a new product to the farm's catalogue, and for egg products ties it to the egg grades it is sold from.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: New product checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Checks a new product's details are filled in properly before it is added.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Eggs per pack lookup
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Tells other parts of the app how many eggs go into each packed unit, such as a carton.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Product and pack-size records
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Lists how products and eggs-per-pack settings are looked up and saved in the database.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Turn product on or off
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Switches a product on or off for sale without deleting it.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Changing eggs per pack
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Changes how many eggs a packed unit holds, such as the number in a carton.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Eggs per pack checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Checks an eggs-per-pack change is valid before it is saved.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Editing a product
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Changes a product's details, such as its name, unit and default price.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Product edit checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Checks a product's changed details are valid before they are saved.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Add order line request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: The details needed to add a product line to an order; unit and price fall back to the product's defaults.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Confirm sale request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: The details needed to confirm an order as a sale, including any discount and its reason, and the reply sent back.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: New customer request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: The details needed to add a customer.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: New product request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: The details needed to add a product.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: New order request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: The details needed to start a new sales order.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Customer balance
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Holds the amount a customer still owes.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Customer name card
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Holds a customer's current name and contact details so order lists can show who each order is for.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Sales sample data access
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Lets the sample-data loaders read and write customers, products and orders; not available in the live system.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Sales module front door
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Lists what other parts of the app can ask the sales side for, with the shapes of products, customers, orders and payments.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Eggs per pack for other modules
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Lets other parts of the app look up how many eggs a packed unit holds.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Starting pack sizes
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Lets farm setup create the first eggs-per-pack settings for a new account.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Record payment request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: The details needed to record a customer's payment against an order.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Order list filter
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: The choices staff can use to narrow the list of sales orders.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Settlement visibility
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Sets how much of the money-still-owed figure a particular lookup is allowed to show.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Edit customer request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: The details needed to change a customer's record.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Change eggs per pack request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: The details needed to change how many eggs a packed unit holds.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Edit order line request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: The details needed to change a line on an order.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Edit product request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: The details needed to change a product.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Cancel payment request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: The details needed to cancel a payment recorded by mistake.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Cancel sale request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: The details needed to undo a confirmed sale, and the reply sent back.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Adding a customer
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Adds a new customer to the farm's customer list.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: New customer checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Checks a new customer has the required details before being added.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Customer records
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Lists how customers are looked up and saved in the database.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Editing a customer
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Changes an existing customer's details.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Customer edit checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Checks a customer's changed details are valid before they are saved.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Adding a line to an order
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Adds a product line to a draft order, filling in the product's default unit and price and recording the list price and any discount against it.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Order line checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Checks a new order line has a valid product, quantity and price before it is added.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Cancelling an order
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Cancels an order that has not yet been confirmed.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Sales module
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Carries out the sales side's work for other parts of the app: products, customers, orders and payments.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Confirming a sale
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Confirms an order as a sale, takes the eggs from stock oldest first, records the discount, and refuses if stock is short.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Confirm sale checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Checks the discount on a sale is filled in properly before it is confirmed.
